import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = '/tmp/sharpforge-a03-normal-instance-fields';
const baselineRoot = '/tmp/sharpforge-a03-fields-baseline';
const evidence = '/tmp/a03-fields-validation';
const candidateHead = '7d65292a310fc0b397a04b3c0828d7a0f8b29dd6';
const baselineHead = '594085da988a5b9439625f0577b958a166121666';
assert.match(process.version, /^v24\./);
assert.equal(process.env.SHARPFORGE_MAX_PARALLEL_RUNS, '1');
assert.equal(process.env.SHARPFORGE_TEST_CONCURRENCY, '1');
assert.equal(process.env.SHARPFORGE_MAX_OLD_SPACE_MB, '1024');
mkdirSync(evidence, { recursive: true });
const records = [];
const hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
function run(label, command, args, expected = 0, cwd = root) {
  const log = path.join(evidence, `${label}.log`);
  writeFileSync(log, '', { flag: 'wx' });
  const started = new Date().toISOString();
  const result = spawnSync(command, args, { cwd, env: process.env, encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 32 * 1024 * 1024 });
  writeFileSync(log, result.stdout + result.stderr);
  records.push({ label, command, args, cwd, started, completed: new Date().toISOString(),
    exitCode: result.status, signal: result.signal, error: result.error?.message });
  writeFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'commands.json'), JSON.stringify(records, null, 2) + '\n');
  process.stdout.write(`${label}: ${result.status}\n${result.stdout}${result.stderr}`);
  assert.equal(result.status, expected, `${label}: unexpected exit`);
  assert.equal(result.signal, null, `${label}: signal`);
  return result.stdout.trim();
}
const node = (label, args, expected) => run(label, process.execPath, args, expected);
assert.equal(run('candidate-head', 'git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']), candidateHead);
assert.equal(run('candidate-clean', 'git', ['status', '--porcelain']), '');
run('baseline-create', 'git', ['worktree', 'add', '--detach', baselineRoot, baselineHead]);
assert.equal(run('baseline-head', 'git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], 0, baselineRoot), baselineHead);
assert.equal(run('baseline-clean', 'git', ['status', '--porcelain'], 0, baselineRoot), '');
const inputs = ['tests/fixtures/verifier-fields/input.js', 'tests/fixtures/verifier-fields/cases.js',
  'tests/fixtures/verifier-fields/baseline.mjs', 'packages/cil/tools/benchmark-field-verifier.mjs'];
for (const file of inputs) {
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(baselineRoot, file)), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(path.join(baselineRoot, file), readFileSync(path.join(root, file)), { flag: 'wx' });
}
const controlFiles = ['packages/cil/tools/benchmark-numeric-verifier.mjs', 'tests/fixtures/verifier-numeric/input.js',
  'tests/managed-fixtures.js', 'tests/fixtures/a03-type-categories/input.js', 'tests/fixtures/a03-metadata/fixture.js',
  'tests/fixtures/a03-type-categories/native-input.js', 'tests/fixtures/a03-type-categories/native.json'];
const sourceFiles = run('source-files', 'git', ['ls-files', 'packages/cil/src']).split('\n');
const baselineFiles = run('baseline-source-files', 'git', ['ls-files', 'packages/cil/src'], 0, baselineRoot).split('\n');
const manifests = run('manifest-files', 'git', ['ls-files', 'package.json', 'package-lock.json', 'packages/*/package.json']).split('\n');
const hashFiles = (directory, files) => Object.fromEntries(files.map(file => [file, hash(readFileSync(path.join(directory, file)))]));
const sourceBefore = hashFiles(root, sourceFiles);
const proof = { candidateHead, baselineHead, sourceBefore, baselineSource: hashFiles(baselineRoot, baselineFiles),
  baselineInputs: hashFiles(baselineRoot, [...inputs, ...controlFiles]), candidateInputs: hashFiles(root, [...inputs, ...controlFiles]),
  candidateManifests: hashFiles(root, manifests), baselineManifests: hashFiles(baselineRoot, manifests),
  driverSHA256: hash(readFileSync('/tmp/a03-fields-validate.mjs')), browserDriverSHA256: hash(readFileSync('/tmp/a03-fields-browser.py')) };
assert.deepEqual(proof.baselineInputs, proof.candidateInputs);
assert.deepEqual(proof.baselineManifests, proof.candidateManifests);
writeFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'source-proof.json'), JSON.stringify(proof, null, 2) + '\n');
run('install', 'npm', ['ci', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund']);
run('baseline-install', 'npm', ['ci', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], 0, baselineRoot);
proof.workspaceLinks = {};
for (const [name, directory] of [['candidate', root], ['baseline', baselineRoot]]) {
  const link = realpathSync(path.join(directory, 'node_modules/@sharpforge/cil'));
  assert.equal(link, realpathSync(path.join(directory, 'packages/cil')));
  proof.workspaceLinks[name] = link;
}
writeFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'source-proof.json'), JSON.stringify(proof, null, 2) + '\n');
const red = run('baseline-red', process.execPath, ['tests/fixtures/verifier-fields/baseline.mjs'], 1, baselineRoot);
assert.match(red, /A normal field load with canonical core identity must be typed/);
assert.match(red, /unknown/);
for (const [mode, script, extra] of [['numeric', 'benchmark-numeric-verifier.mjs', []],
  ['fields', 'benchmark-field-verifier.mjs', ['baseline']]]) {
  run(`baseline-${mode}-performance`, process.execPath, [`packages/cil/tools/${script}`,
    path.join(evidence, `baseline-${mode}-performance.json`), ...extra], 0, baselineRoot);
}
node('native', ['tests/fixtures/verifier-fields/capture.mjs', path.join(evidence, 'native.json')]);
writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'tests/fixtures/verifier-fields/native.json'),
  readFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'native.json')), { flag: 'wx' });
node('focused-tests', ['--test', '--test-concurrency=1',
  'tests/a03-field-transfers.test.js', 'tests/a03-field-ancestry.test.js', 'tests/a03-field-native.test.js',
  'tests/a03-numeric-transfers.test.js', 'tests/a03-local-initialization.test.js',
  'tests/a03-type-categories.test.js', 'tests/a03-type-categories-native.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-nested-type-references.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-local-type-references.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-local-type-references-native.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-type-system.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-type-system-native.test.js', 'tests/a03-verification-types.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-members.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-members-inherited.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-type-access.test.js',
  'tests/a03-07-nested-access.test.js', 'tests/a03-07-member-access.test.js', 'tests/a03-coded-index-bounds.test.js']);
run('browser', '/tmp/sharpforge-bcl-browser-venv/bin/python',
  ['/tmp/a03-fields-browser.py', root, path.join(evidence, 'browser')]);
for (const [mode, script, extra] of [['numeric', 'benchmark-numeric-verifier.mjs', []],
  ['fields', 'benchmark-field-verifier.mjs', ['candidate']]]) {
  node(`candidate-${mode}-performance`, [`packages/cil/tools/${script}`, path.join(evidence, `candidate-${mode}-performance.json`), ...extra]);
}
node('manifests', ['scripts/planning/check-test-manifests.js']);
node('syntax', ['scripts/check.js']);
node('static-imports', ['scripts/conformance/static/check-imports.js', '--output', path.join(evidence, 'static-imports.json')]);
node('structure', ['scripts/quality/check-structure.js']);
run('diff-check', 'git', ['diff', '--check']);
assert.deepEqual(hashFiles(root, sourceFiles), sourceBefore);
proof.sourceAfter = hashFiles(root, sourceFiles);
assert.deepEqual(hashFiles(baselineRoot, baselineFiles), proof.baselineSource);
assert.deepEqual(hashFiles(root, [...inputs, ...controlFiles]), proof.candidateInputs);
assert.deepEqual(hashFiles(baselineRoot, [...inputs, ...controlFiles]), proof.baselineInputs);
proof.finalHead = run('final-head', 'git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
assert.equal(proof.finalHead, candidateHead);
writeFileSync(path.join(evidence, 'source-proof.json'), JSON.stringify(proof, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log(`Validation evidence: ${evidence}`);
